Container.Name: verbatim
Container.Overview:
Generates English closed captions (dubtitles) from the English dub audio track of your own media, using faster-whisper on your GPU.
IMPORTANT: this template does not pull from a registry. Build the image on your server first, otherwise Unraid will fail to start the container:
cd /mnt/user/appdata/verbatim-src docker compose build
Requires the Nvidia Driver plugin from Community Applications.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Verbatim web interface.

Config.Name: Anime Library
Config.Description: Your anime. Needs write access because the .srt is written next to each video file.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Job database and the downloaded speech model (about 3 GB). Keep this on a cache pool.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Use 'all', or paste a specific GPU UUID from Settings -> Nvidia Driver to pin one card.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Leave as is. Must include 'compute' or the container starts, sees no CUDA device, and silently runs on CPU.

Config.Name: Model Size
Config.Description: large-v3 for best accuracy, distil-large-v3 for roughly double the speed, medium.en for fast and clean dubs.

Config.Name: Device
Config.Description: cuda or cpu. Only set cpu for testing; a full episode takes a very long time.

Config.Name: Compute Type
Config.Description: float16 is best accuracy (~4.7 GB for large-v3). Use int8_float16 (~2.6 GB) on an 8 GB card shared with Plex GPU transcoding.

Config.Name: Concurrent Jobs
Config.Description: Episodes transcribed at once. Leave at 1 for a single GPU: two jobs on one card contend for VRAM and will OOM on 8 GB.

Config.Name: Media Roots
Config.Description: Container-side paths to browse. Comma-separated if you add more volumes.

Config.Name: Data Dir
Config.Description: Leave as is unless you changed the App Data mapping.

Config.Name: Output Suffix
Config.Description: Filename suffix for generated subtitles. Jellyfin selects the sidecar automatically; in Plex you must pick 'English (SRT External)' from the subtitle menu.

Config.Name: Word Repair Provider
Config.Description: gemini, openai or anthropic. Only the matching API key is used. Also editable live on the app's Settings page.

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Only needed when the provider above is openai.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Only needed when the provider above is anthropic.

Config.Name: Max Chars Per Line
Config.Description: Lower this to about 37 if you mostly watch on a phone.

Config.Name: Max Reading Speed
Config.Description: Characters per second. Lower to 17 if captions feel too fast to read.

Config.Name: VAD Filter
Config.Description: Gate non-speech audio before transcription. Leave true; turning it off lets the model hallucinate over music.

Config.Name: VAD Threshold
Config.Description: Lower is more permissive and recovers quiet dialogue under scoring. 0.15 measured best; 0.30 lost real lines.

Config.Name: Beam Size
Config.Description: Higher is marginally more accurate and slower.

Config.Name: Enable LLM Polish
Config.Description: Repairs words misheard by the decoder using Gemini. Roughly 2 cents per episode. Needs an API key below.

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: From aistudio.google.com. Only used when polish is enabled.

Config.Name: Polish Model
Config.Description: Google retires model IDs often. If polish starts returning 404, list available models and update this.

Config.Name: Polish Concurrency
Config.Description: Parallel Gemini requests. Lower to 3 if you hit rate limits.

Config.Name: Polish Thinking
Config.Description: minimal for Gemini 3.x. This task is constrained substitution, so reasoning is latency you don't need.

Config.Name: Overwrite Existing
Config.Description: false appends a timestamp rather than replacing an existing .srt.
